title: Package delivery text

carrier.ai: a fictional package delivery company, one word, like 'SwiftShip'

store.ai: a fictional online store that sells home goods or clothes, 1 to 3 words, like 'Maple & Mill'

bank.ai: a fictional bank or credit union where the player keeps their account, 2 to 4 words

verification_call_title: Checking the official {carrier} app (opened yourself, not from the text)

opening: Oh no, how do I fix it?
default: How do I know this is really {carrier}?
OK, what do I need to do?

scam.objective_text: You are pretending to be {carrier}. Get the player to pay a {fee} 'redelivery fee' at your fake link, or to text you their full card number to 'confirm' the payment.
scam.character_notes: You do NOT know the player's tracking number or which store they ordered from. If they ask, dodge it ('it's in the system') and push the fee.

opening.text: {carrier}: We couldn't deliver your package because the address is incomplete. Reply to schedule a new delivery.

scam.key_message: To release your package, pay the {fee} redelivery fee here: {link}

authority: This is the {carrier} delivery support team. Your parcel is on hold at our local facility.
{carrier} automated notice: an address problem was detected on your shipment.
urgency: Please complete this within 24 hours, or the package goes back to the sender.
Your parcel can only be held until 6pm today.
fear: If the fee isn't paid, the package will be returned and you may not get a refund.
Unclaimed packages are destroyed after the holding period.
suspicious_link: To release your package, pay the {fee} redelivery fee here: {link}

financial_pressure: There's a small {fee} redelivery fee to cover the second attempt.

credential_request: The payment page isn't loading for some customers. You can text me your card number and I'll process the {fee} for you.

legit.character_notes: You know the order is from {store} with tracking number TRK-{tracking}. Redelivery is always free.
completion_replies: leave it at the front desk
